== Lanfear ==

The latest editor removed the following from the section about Lanfear as potential visitor of the Chamber: ''"She was perhaps taken away from the chamber by an unidentified man (perhaps [[Moridin]]) addressing Moiraine, saying it wasn't her he was looking for."'' I'm inclined reinstate that line. The section of the deals with people who have or may have been in the chamber – how they got there and how they left. It's somewhat speculative, but based on what Moiraine says about the unidentified man saying he ”didn't come for her” I think could be included. Anyone has a comment? --[[User:JackEriksson|JackEriksson]] 22:53, January 21, 2011 (UTC)
